theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (w : NVector (Eucl P) n) (c : Covector (Eucl P) n), w c = ∑ I : SimonMultiIndex n P, euclideanCovectorCoordinate c I * w (wedgeCovectors n (fun j => EuclideanSpace.proj (I j))) ∧ ∀ I : SimonMultiIndex n P, |euclideanCovectorCoordinate c I| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm c
